name: M5PatientIntake
title: Patient Intake Questionnaire
description: Patient intake form for SMART Health Check-in testing. Adapted from Medplum's patient intake questionnaire (https://github.com/medplum/medplum-patient-intake-demo, Apache License 2.0), with SDC expression-based population so a wallet can prefill it from the patient's own FHIR records, inline answer lists in place of value sets that need a terminology server, and SSN and gender identity made optional. A practice adopting it replaces "[Practice Name]" with its own name.

item.text: I the undersigned patient (or authorized representative, or parent/guardian), consent to and authorize the performance of any treatments, examinations, medical services, surgical or diagnostic procedures, including lab and radiographic studies, as ordered by this office and it’s healthcare providers.

I, the responsible party, hereby agree to pay all the charges submitted by this office during the course of treatment for the patient. If the patient has insurance coverage with a managed care organization, with which this office has a contractual agreement, I agree to pay all applicable co‐payments, co‐insurance and deductibles, which arise during the course of treatment for the patient. The responsible party also agrees to pay for treatment rendered to the patient, which is not considered to be a covered service by my insurer and/or a third party insurer or other payor. I understand that [Practice Name] provides charges on a sliding fee; based on family size and household annual income, and that services will not be refused due to inability to pay at the time of the visit.

[Practice Name] Notice of Privacy Practices gives information about how [Practice Name] may use and release protected health information (PHI) about you. I understand that:
- I have the right to receive a copy of [Practice Name]’s Notice of Privacy Practices.
- I may request a copy at any time.
- [Practice Name]‘s Notice of Privacy Practices may be revised.
I acknowledge the above and that I have received a copy of [Practice Name]’s Notice of Privacy Practices.
An Advance Medical Directive is a document by which a person makes provision for health care decisions in the event that, in the future, he/she becomes unable to make those decisions.
I acknowledge I have received information about Advance Directives.
Ok to send email appointment reminders
